overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus S-Line 2-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness experience right at home. Crafted from elegant Natural Pacific Cedar wood, this sauna combines 7 advanced heating elements, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, to deliver soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Ideal for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms, it features a Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built-in speakers, allowing you to enjoy your favorite tunes while unwinding. With its easy clasp-together assembly and stylish bronze privacy tempered glass door, this sauna is a perfect addition to your wellness routine.
